ledgerHelp99: Recorded sales and local requests are separate. An accepted request does not move money.
emptyHelp99: Adjust the filters or refresh sales.
partial99: Incomplete or unavailable query. Totals remain unknown.
auto99: Refreshes every minute while this screen is visible.
invalid99: The records could not be validated. Refresh before continuing.
range99: Check the period: the end date cannot precede the start date.
invalidBag99: This cash bag history needs review. No stage will be changed.
bagHelp99: Prepare the bag from the confirmed cash count. Each stage is recorded on this computer.
sealConfirm99: Confirm sealing with the counted amount and this recipient?
localOnly99: Recorded only on this computer. Handover and receipt across devices require an integrated connection.
copyFailed99: Could not copy. Select the displayed code.
countHelp99: Count notes and coins; the system sums and compares with the sealed amount.
countZero99: Enter the count, including when there is no cash.
notBalance99: This is not the drawer balance. Official opening funds, withdrawals and deposits need a separate query.
closeFirst99: Confirm the closing cash count before recording the seal.
error99: Could not complete. Refresh and try again.
emptyBag99: There is no counted cash to place in a bag.
